{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load data and apply fixes
# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline == -999
data_clean = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient_id
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq, then drop duplicates keeping the last (highest sample_seq)
data_clean = data_clean.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
data_clean = data_clean.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check final size
print(f'Final dataset size: {data_clean.shape}')

# Check distribution of arms and severity
print('\nArm distribution:')
print(data_clean["arm"].value_counts())

print('\nSeverity distribution:')
print(data_clean["severity"].value_counts())

# Check if arm and severity are confounded
print('\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity:')
print(pd.crosstab(data_clean["arm"], data_clean["severity"]))"}
